title: HtmlOptgroup
responsibility: Renders the native optgroup element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlOptgroup.attributes
inputs.description: Native optgroup attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlOptgroup.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native optgroup element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlOptgroup
outputs.description: The actual native optgroup element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
